Title: Deep Song vs. Armor of Caine's Fury (LSJ)

Messages.Author: Jarkko Suvela
Messages.Body:
My friend asked me a question I really don't have an answer, so how
it goes here?

Meth A. rushes with Deep Song (frenzy)
Meth B. plays Armor of Caine's Fury before range is Determined
(cancels ongoing frenzies and cannot be frenzied)

-Will Meth B remain as active player as Deep Song suggests or will
the active player change?

thanks in advance!

PS.
When using Undele's special vote ability to get 2 minion cards from
ash heap, can you name a card that you don't have in your ash heap?
use the same card in votepush (burn vote card from your hand to get +1
vote from it)

-Jarkko
